# Export format

<!-- Generated by app/src/lib/server/export-format.spec.ts from the schema. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Einstellungen → Export** downloads a ZIP with every record of an account. This page describes its files so that another program can read them without mietkartei. The user guide is [Umziehen und Daten mitnehmen](https://docs.mietkartei.de/anleitungen/umziehen/).

## Files

- `export.json`: every table of the account, described below.
- `documents/<id>-<name>`: every uploaded document as uploaded; `<id>` is its row in `documents`.
- `FEHLENDE-DOKUMENTE.txt`: only when a document row has no file in storage; lists those documents.
- `tabellen/*.csv`: `tabellen/objekte-und-einheiten.csv`, `tabellen/mieter.csv`, `tabellen/mietvertraege.csv`, `tabellen/zahlungen.csv`, `tabellen/ausgaben.csv`. The main records once more as spreadsheets, with the same columns as the CSV import (**Einstellungen → Datenübernahme**): semicolons, UTF-8 with byte order mark, amounts like `650,00`, dates like `01.01.2025`. They are a convenience copy; `export.json` is complete.

## export.json

```json
{ "format": "mietkartei", "version": 1, "schema": "<last migration>", "exportedAt": "<ISO 8601>", "accountId": "<id>", "tables": { "<table>": [ { "<field>": <value> } ] } }
```

- `format` is always `mietkartei`, `version` 1 for this layout of the file.
- `schema` is the last database migration of the instance that wrote the file (see `app/drizzle/`). A newer instance upgrades the rows of an older export when it restores it ([MIGRATIONS.md](MIGRATIONS.md#exports-from-older-versions)); exports written before November 27, 2026 have no `schema`.
- `tables` holds one array of rows per table, parents before children, so the rows can be created in order. A row is an object keyed by the field names below (not the SQL column names).
- Amounts are integer euro cents (`65000` = 650,00 €) unless a field says otherwise. Dates are ISO strings (`2025-01-31`), months `2025-01`. Timestamps are ISO 8601 strings in UTC. Ids are UUIDs, except where a field says otherwise.
- `users` leaves out password hashes. API keys, bank connection sessions and notification channels are not exported: they are credentials of the instance, not the landlord’s data.

### `users`

A person who signs in. Each user works in exactly one account.

| Field                    | Type                         | Required | Description                                                                                                                            |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                     | text                         |          |                                                                                                                                        |
| `accountId`              | text                         | yes      | References `accounts.id`.                                                                                                              |
| `email`                  | text                         | yes      | Stored trimmed and in lower case; unique across all accounts.                                                                          |
| `passwordHash`           | text                         | yes      |                                                                                                                                        |
| `role`                   | `owner`, `manager`, `viewer` |          | Owners manage invitations and bank accounts; managers edit everything else; viewers only read (the hook refuses their writes).         |
| `name`                   | text                         |          |                                                                                                                                        |
| `showPropertyMaps`       | boolean                      |          | Whether the property list shows each property on a small map of Germany.                                                               |
| `theme`                  | `system`, `light`, `dark`    |          | Light or dark colours, or whatever the device is set to.                                                                               |
| `amountInput`            | `comma`, `datev`             |          | How the user types amounts: with a comma, or like DATEV (600 = 6,00 €).                                                                |
| `deadlineMailOrigin`     | text                         |          | The weekly Fristenübersicht by mail: the address of the app its links lead to, taken when the user turned it on; null while it is off. |
| `deadlineMailSentOn`     | text                         |          | The day the last Fristenübersicht went out (or was due without anything in it).                                                        |
| `notificationHour`       | integer                      |          | The hour in Germany from which the day's Hinweise go out, 6 to 21.                                                                     |
| `notificationWeekends`   | boolean                      |          | Whether Hinweise also go out on Saturdays and Sundays; otherwise they wait for Monday.                                                 |
| `notificationsCheckedOn` | text                         |          | The day the user's entries were last checked for Hinweise.                                                                             |
| `createdAt`              | timestamp (ISO 8601)         |          |                                                                                                                                        |

### `email_changes`

A new email address waiting for confirmation. The id is the SHA-256 hash of the token in the link sent to the new address; valid for one day.

| Field       | Type                 | Required | Description               |
| ----------- | -------------------- | -------- | ------------------------- |
| `id`        | text                 | yes      |                           |
| `accountId` | text                 | yes      | References `accounts.id`. |
| `userId`    | text                 | yes      | References `users.id`.    |
| `email`     | text                 | yes      |                           |
| `expiresAt` | timestamp (ISO 8601) | yes      |                           |
| `createdAt` | timestamp (ISO 8601) |          |                           |

### `invitations`

An invitation to join the account as a manager or viewer. Only the hash of the link token is stored. Revoked and resent invitations stay, so the daily limit of invitations counts them too; every invitation is deleted a month after its expiry.

| Field        | Type                 | Required | Description               |
| ------------ | -------------------- | -------- | ------------------------- |
| `id`         | text                 |          |                           |
| `accountId`  | text                 | yes      | References `accounts.id`. |
| `email`      | text                 | yes      |                           |
| `role`       | `manager`, `viewer`  |          |                           |
| `tokenHash`  | text                 | yes      |                           |
| `expiresAt`  | timestamp (ISO 8601) | yes      |                           |
| `invitedBy`  | text                 |          | References `users.id`.    |
| `acceptedAt` | timestamp (ISO 8601) |          |                           |
| `revokedAt`  | timestamp (ISO 8601) |          |                           |
| `createdAt`  | timestamp (ISO 8601) |          |                           |

### `lettings`

Neuvermietung: finding a tenant for a unit that is or becomes free. It holds the terms the unit is offered at, which the applicants' rent burden and the lease of the chosen one start from. Once closed (a tenant was chosen or the landlord stopped), it is deleted with all its applicants after the retention period, see domain/applicants.ts.

| Field                     | Type                 | Required | Description                                                             |
| ------------------------- | -------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                      | text                 |          |                                                                         |
| `accountId`               | text                 | yes      | References `accounts.id`.                                               |
| `unitId`                  | text                 | yes      | References `units.id`.                                                  |
| `availableFrom`           | text                 |          | The day the unit is free; null: by arrangement.                         |
| `baseRent`                | integer              |          | The terms offered, in cents, as in a lease.                             |
| `operatingCostPrepayment` | integer              |          |                                                                         |
| `heatingCostPrepayment`   | integer              |          |                                                                         |
| `securityDeposit`         | integer              |          |                                                                         |
| `requiresWbs`             | boolean              |          | Geförderter Wohnraum: the tenant needs a Wohnberechtigungsschein (WBS). |
| `notes`                   | text                 |          |                                                                         |
| `closedAt`                | text                 |          | The day it was closed; null while the landlord is looking for a tenant. |
| `createdAt`               | timestamp (ISO 8601) |          |                                                                         |

### `applicants`

Mietinteressent of a Neuvermietung, with the Mieterselbstauskunft. The questions follow the DSK Orientierungshilfe on Selbstauskünfte (2026): no nationality, marital status, length of employment or former landlords. Proofs are recorded as the day they were shown, never as copies. A rejected or withdrawn applicant is deleted after the retention period, counted from decidedOn; see domain/applicants.ts.

| Field                   | Type                                                                            | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                              |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`                    | text                                                                            |          |                                                                                                                                                                          |

| `lettingId`             | text                                                                            | yes      | References `lettings.id`.                                                                                                                                                |
| `status`                | `new`, `viewing`, `applied`, `shortlisted`, `accepted`, `rejected`, `withdrawn` |          |                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `salutation`            | text                                                                            |          |                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `firstName`             | text                                                                            | yes      |                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `lastName`              | text                                                                            | yes      |                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `email`                 | text                                                                            |          |                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `phone`                 | text                                                                            |          |                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `street`                | text                                                                            |          | The current address.                                                                                                                                                     |
| `postalCode`            | text                                                                            |          |                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `city`                  | text                                                                            |          |                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `viewingAt`             | text                                                                            |          | The viewing appointment, local time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.                                                                                                                 |
| `birthDate`             | text                                                                            |          | Selbstauskunft, all optional: who moves in and what they live on.                                                                                                        |

### `leases`

Mietvertrag: a lease for one main unit (plus extra units in lease_units). The rent and persons columns hold the initial values; the values valid on a day come from rent_changes and lease_persons. Amounts in euro cents.

| Field                     | Type                                    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                      | text                                    |          |                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `accountId`               | text                                    | yes      | References `accounts.id`.                                                                                                                                           |
| `unitId`                  | text                                    | yes      | References `units.id`.                                                                                                                                              |
| `startDate`               | text                                    | yes      | ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).                                                                                                                                              |
| `endDate`                 | text                                    |          | ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); null while the lease runs indefinitely.                                                                                                      |
| `baseRent`                | integer                                 | yes      |                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `parkingRent`             | integer                                 |          | The part of baseRent for a parking space or garage rented with the unit.                                                                                            |
| `operatingCostPrepayment` | integer                                 |          |                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `heatingCostPrepayment`   | integer                                 |          |                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `securityDeposit`         | integer                                 |          |                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `kind`                    | `residential`, `commercial`, `parking`  |          |                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `rentModel`               | `fixed`, `graduated`, `indexed`         |          |                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `operatingCostModel`      | `prepayment`, `flat`, `inclusive`       |          |                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `heatingCostModel`        | `prepayment`, `flat`, `tenant_contract` |          |                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `persons`                 | integer                                 |          | Occupants at the start, for the persons allocation key; later values in lease_persons.                                                                              |
| `rentDueDay`              | integer                                 |          | The rent is due on the n-th working day of the month (§ 556b BGB: the third).                                                                                       |
| `ledgerStart`             | text                                    |          | The ledger starts here instead of at startDate when the lease is entered later, so a lease from 2015 does not show ten years of arrears. Null = startDate.          |
| `terminatedAt`            | text                                    |          | ISO date notice was given and by whom, null while none.                                                                                                             |
| `terminatedBy`            | `tenant`, `landlord`                    |          |                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `indexBaseMonth`          | text                                    |          | For indexed rents: the VPI month and value the current rent is based on.                                                                                            |
| `indexBaseValue`          | number                                  |          |                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `indexBaseYear`           | text                                    |          | The base year (= 100) of indexBaseValue; a proposal needs VPI values of the same year.                                                                              |
| `notes`                   | text                                    |          |                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `mainTenantId`            | text                                    |          | The tenant the lease names (letters, lists) unless all tenants share a last name, see domain/addressee.ts. Null, or one no longer a party: the first party by name. |
| `createdAt`               | timestamp (ISO 8601)                    |          |                                                                                                                                                                     |

### `lease_tenants`

A lease can have several tenants, and a tenant can have several leases.

| Field      | Type | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                          |
| ---------- | ---- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `leaseId`  | text | yes      | References `leases.id`.                                                                                                                                              |
| `tenantId` | text | yes      | References `tenants.id`.                                                                                                                                             |
| `joinedOn` | text |          | The day a tenant became a party to the lease after its start (a Nachtrag), and the last day of one who left it before its end. Null: from the start, and to the end. |
| `leftOn`   | text |          |                                                                                                                                                                      |

### `lease_units`

Extra units rented with the main unit, e.g. a parking space. The main unit is not repeated. Changing the units of a running lease means ending it and starting a new one.

| Field       | Type | Required | Description               |
| ----------- | ---- | -------- | ------------------------- |
| `accountId` | text | yes      | References `accounts.id`. |
| `leaseId`   | text | yes      | References `leases.id`.   |
| `unitId`    | text | yes      | References `units.id`.    |

### `rent_charges`

Sollstellung: what the tenant owes for a month (kind `rent`, derived from the rent history and kept in sync by the ledger module) or from a statement, a CO₂ split or a manual adjustment. Positive = the tenant owes, negative = a credit to the tenant.

| `period`                  | text                                                           | yes      | YYYY-MM                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `dueDate`                 | text                                                           |          | Null while the charge is not due yet: a statement's Nachzahlung is due 30 days after the statement reached the tenant, which is not known before the delivery date is recorded. |
| `baseRent`                | integer                                                        |          |                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `parkingRent`             | integer                                                        |          | The part of baseRent for a parking space or garage, see leases.parkingRent.                                                                                                     |

| `referenceId`             | text                                                           |          | The statement or CO₂ split this charge comes from.                                                                                                                              |
| `reversesChargeId`        | text                                                           |          | A correction or a late delivery reverses a statement's charge: a row of its own. References `rent_charges.id`.                                                                  |
| `note`                    | text                                                           |          |                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `createdAt`               | timestamp (ISO 8601)                                           |          |                                                                                                                                                                                 |

### `deposit_settlements`

Kautionsabrechnung: the settlement of the deposit after the lease ended, one per lease, with its letter. Its bookings (interest, Einbehalte, the offset against arrears and the payout) are deposit movements and a payment that point to it and go with it.

| Field        | Type                 | Required | Description                                                            |
| ------------ | -------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`         | text                 |          |                                                                        |
| `accountId`  | text                 | yes      | References `accounts.id`.                                              |
| `leaseId`    | text                 | yes      | References `leases.id`.                                                |
| `date`       | text                 | yes      | The date of the letter and of its bookings.                            |
| `payout`     | integer              | yes      | Paid back to the tenant; 0 when the deductions take the whole deposit. |
| `remaining`  | integer              | yes      | Arrears left on the rent ledger after the offset.                      |
| `items`      | text                 | yes      | Rows of the letter's table: item and amount.                           |
| `letterText` | text                 | yes      |                                                                        |
| `createdAt`  | timestamp (ISO 8601) |          |                                                                        |

| `notes`     | text                  |          |                           |

### `contra_accounts`

Gegenkonto: the landlord's own account of their bookkeeping, e.g. „4401 Grundsteuer“ or „8005 Mieten Rudolf“, that a bank transaction is booked to. The number is the landlord's own and optional. An expense account carries the expense category; any account may name the property it belongs to, which a booking then defaults to.

| `expenseCategory` | `operating_costs`, `association_fee`, `special_levy`, `special_levy_reserve`, `maintenance`, `loan_payment`, `loan_interest`, `loan_repayment`, `management`, `modernization`, `other` |          | Set for kind expense only.  |
| `propertyId`      | text                                                                                                                                                                                   |          | References `properties.id`. |

| `createdAt`        | timestamp (ISO 8601) |          |                                                                                                          |

### `insurance_policies`

Versicherung of a property. It renews every year on `renewalDate` (Hauptfälligkeit) until `endDate`; the notice deadline before each renewal is computed in deadlines.ts.

| Field           | Type                                                                        | Required | Description                                                                        |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`            | text                                                                        |          |                                                                                    |
| `accountId`     | text                                                                        | yes      | References `accounts.id`.                                                          |
| `propertyId`    | text                                                                        | yes      | References `properties.id`.                                                        |
| `kind`          | `building`, `liability`, `glass`, `oil_tank`, `rent_loss`, `legal`, `other` | yes      |                                                                                    |
| `insurer`       | text                                                                        | yes      |                                                                                    |
| `policyNumber`  | text                                                                        |          |                                                                                    |
| `annualPremium` | integer                                                                     | yes      | Premium per insurance year in cents.                                               |
| `renewalDate`   | text                                                                        | yes      | The first day of an insurance year; later years start on the same day of the year. |
| `noticeMonths`  | integer                                                                     |          | Months before the end of an insurance year by which a cancellation must arrive.    |
| `endDate`       | text                                                                        |          | The last day of cover once the policy is cancelled.                                |
| `note`          | text                                                                        |          |                                                                                    |
| `createdAt`     | timestamp (ISO 8601)                                                        |          |                                                                                    |

### `cost_items`

| `fuel`                | `gas`, `oil`, `lpg`, `district_heating`, `other` |          | For a fuel bill of a central heating: what the supplier printed, so the statement can deduct the landlord's CO₂ share (CO2KostAufG) before allocating. All optional.                                                                                                     |

All or none. |
| `associationKey`      | text                                             |          |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `associationKeyTotal` | number                                           |          |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

References `insurance_policies.id`.                                                                                                                                                |

### `cost_item_unit_amounts`

Amounts per unit for a cost item with a `direct` key, e.g. from a Messdienstleister. A unit that changed tenants in the item's period has either one row for the unit (split by days between its leases) or one row per lease (the Messdienst's amount per Nutzer after a Zwischenablesung, § 9b HeizKV); the vacancy has no row and stays with the landlord.

| Field        | Type    | Required | Description                                                 |
| ------------ | ------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `accountId`  | text    | yes      | References `accounts.id`.                                   |
| `costItemId` | text    | yes      | References `cost_items.id`.                                 |
| `unitId`     | text    | yes      | References `units.id`.                                      |
| `leaseId`    | text    |          | Null: the amount of the whole unit. References `leases.id`. |
| `amount`     | integer | yes      |                                                             |

### `meters`

Zähler: a meter of the building (unitId null) or of one unit. A replaced meter is closed with removedAt and the new one opened with installedAt; consumption is clipped to that lifetime.

| Field          | Type                                                    | Required | Description                                  |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `id`           | text                                                    |          |                                              |
| `accountId`    | text                                                    | yes      | References `accounts.id`.                    |
| `propertyId`   | text                                                    | yes      | References `properties.id`.                  |
| `unitId`       | text                                                    |          | References `units.id`.                       |
| `kind`         | `cold_water`, `hot_water`, `heat`, `gas`, `electricity` | yes      |                                              |
| `serialNumber` | text                                                    |          |                                              |
| `unit`         | text                                                    | yes      | m³, kWh or Einheiten (heat cost allocators). |
| `location`     | text                                                    |          |                                              |
| `installedAt`  | text                                                    |          |                                              |
| `removedAt`    | text                                                    |          |                                              |
| `createdAt`    | timestamp (ISO 8601)                                    |          |                                              |

### `operating_cost_statements`

Betriebskostenabrechnung for a property and period. Drafts are recomputed on every view; an approved statement keeps its computed result frozen in `result` and is never changed again. A correction is a new version with `correctsId` pointing at the version it replaces; "superseded" is derived from the existence of an approved correction.

| Field                   | Type                 | Required | Description                                                                                  |
| ----------------------- | -------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                    | text                 |          |                                                                                              |
| `accountId`             | text                 | yes      | References `accounts.id`.                                                                    |
| `propertyId`            | text                 | yes      | References `properties.id`.                                                                  |
| `periodStart`           | text                 | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `periodEnd`             | text                 | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `version`               | integer              |          |                                                                                              |
| `status`                | `draft`, `approved`  |          |                                                                                              |
| `correctsId`            | text                 |          | No foreign key: it points at an approved version, and approved versions are never deleted.   |
| `result`                | text                 |          | JSON of the computed StatementResult (property level), frozen on approval; null for a draft. |
| `lateApprovalJustified` | boolean              |          | Approval after the 12-month deadline with "Verspätung nicht zu vertreten" (§ 556 Abs. 3).    |
| `approvedAt`            | timestamp (ISO 8601) |          |                                                                                              |
| `approvedBy`            | text                 |          | References `users.id`.                                                                       |
| `note`                  | text                 |          |                                                                                              |
| `createdAt`             | timestamp (ISO 8601) |          |                                                                                              |

### `statement_results`

One lease's part of an approved statement: the frozen per-lease result the PDF is printed from, its balance, and when the statement reached the tenant (starts the Einwendungsfrist and makes a Nachzahlung due).

| Field         | Type                 | Required | Description                                           |
| ------------- | -------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`          | text                 |          |                                                       |
| `accountId`   | text                 | yes      | References `accounts.id`.                             |
| `statementId` | text                 | yes      | References `operating_cost_statements.id`.            |
| `leaseId`     | text                 | yes      | References `leases.id`.                               |
| `balance`     | integer              | yes      | Positive = Nachzahlung, negative = Guthaben.          |
| `result`      | text                 | yes      | JSON of the frozen per-lease result (LeaseStatement). |
| `deliveredOn` | text                 |          |                                                       |
| `createdAt`   | timestamp (ISO 8601) |          |                                                       |

### `association_statements`

Hausgeldabrechnung of an Eigentumswohnung for one Wirtschaftsjahr, as the Verwalter sent it: the unit's share of the costs, split into what may be passed on to the tenant, what may not and the Zuführung zur Erhaltungsrücklage, and the Hausgeld due under the Wirtschaftsplan. The app sets it against the Hausgeld paid (expenses of category association_fee) and the Belege taken over from it. Amounts in cents.

| Field                 | Type                 | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                         |
| --------------------- | -------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                  | text                 |          |                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `accountId`           | text                 | yes      | References `accounts.id`.                                                                                                                                                           |
| `propertyId`          | text                 | yes      | References `properties.id`.                                                                                                                                                         |
| `periodStart`         | text                 | yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `periodEnd`           | text                 | yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `allocableCosts`      | integer              | yes      | Umlagefähige Kosten: the share of the costs that may be passed on (§ 2 BetrKV).                                                                                                     |
| `nonAllocableCosts`   | integer              | yes      | Nicht umlagefähige Kosten, e.g. Verwaltervergütung, Instandhaltung, Bankgebühren.                                                                                                   |
| `reserveContribution` | integer              | yes      | Zuführung zur Erhaltungsrücklage.                                                                                                                                                   |
| `feesDue`             | integer              | yes      | Hausgeld due for the year under the Wirtschaftsplan (Soll-Vorauszahlungen).                                                                                                         |
| `reserveWithdrawal`   | integer              |          | Entnahme aus der Erhaltungsrücklage: the unit's share of what the Verwalter spent from the reserve on Erhaltung in the year. Deductible for tax in that year, unlike the Zuführung. |
| `statedBalance`       | integer              |          | The Abrechnungsspitze the Verwalter printed; positive = Nachzahlung, negative = Guthaben.                                                                                           |
| `note`                | text                 |          |                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `createdAt`           | timestamp (ISO 8601) |          |                                                                                                                                                                                     |
